name: PostgreSQL
description: Relational storage on PostgreSQL, including schema and migration practice.
architecture: Keep the schema in versioned migrations; never edit an applied migration.
Separate read models from write models only when a measured need exists.
structure: Migrations live in the repository and run in order.
Seed data is separate from schema.
conventions: Every foreign key has an index when it is queried.
testing: Test migrations against a disposable database.
Test queries with realistic data volumes where it matters.
security: Do not log query parameters that contain personal data.
documentation: Document backup, restore, and migration steps.
tooling: A migration runner that records applied versions.

compatibility.notes: Assumes a single primary database; replication is out of scope.
